message.content: Starting with broad random sweeps, then targeting rare corners.
Random sweep hit a clearance violation — now I'll shrink it to a minimal case.
Shrunk to a short emergency-triggered case; I'll confirm and inspect the violation.
Replay confirmed the failure — inspecting the steps around the violation to pin down the cause.
Ledger: open - emergency preemption skips clearance/yellow; ruled out - none yet. Checking earlier steps.
At 120 EW was green while the emergency was still inactive — checking the transition steps.
EW yellow seen at 123 with NS going green at 124 — inspecting the steps between to trace the cut-short transition.
Ledger still open on preemption cutting clearance — gathering the final pre-violation step.
Emergency preemption looks like the trigger — testing the same scenario without it as a counterfactual.
Counterfactual with the emergency removed passes — found the cause. Submitting the grounded report.
